---
title: "3. Meet the inputs: DietSwap"
---

## Your task

Locate the three TSV files in `data/dietswap/`.

## The three files

| File | Required structure |
|---|---|
| `feature-counts.tsv` | `feature_id`, followed by sample columns of nonnegative integer counts |
| `sample-metadata.tsv` | `sample_id` and `group`, with one row per sample |
| `taxonomy.tsv` | `feature_id` and `taxon`, with one row per feature |

## Dataset details

The metadata retain participant, nationality, and sampling information. All selected records have timepoint = 1, timepoint.within.group = 1, and study_group = ED. Use these labels when describing the selection; calling it baseline requires supporting study documentation. Review the supplied annotation before naming a particular taxonomic rank.

## Before continuing

Choose one sample ID and locate it in both counts and metadata. Choose one feature ID and locate it in both counts and taxonomy. These identifiers connect the files.
